responsibility: Supplies GCC’s generic operating-system configuration layer for ELF targets. It establishes ELF preprocessor builtins, user label and internal label conventions, default DWARF/CTF/BTF debug support, assembler directives for .file/.zero/.set/.string and case labels, common/object/function declaration macros, ASCII output rules, and default ELF hooks such as recording GCC switches and external symbol emission. This header is the reusable generic ELF OS substrate that many specific targets build upon.
